summary: 48mm double-row omni wheel with a central hub. Two staggered rings of barrel-shaped rollers sit around the rim. The hub has a hex-style center bore and four small through-holes on a square 16mm pattern. The rotation axis is z, and the wheel is centered at the origin.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front hub face with the central bore, the 16mm-pattern hole square and a shallow circular recess around the bore (about 14mm per the spec).
Rear hub face, assumed to mirror the front because the wheel is symmetric about its mid-plane; this face is not directly visible.

notes: The 48mm diameter and 8mm bore come from the listed specs, which are marked unverified. The 16mm hole pattern is stated in the specs and matches the image, where the hole spacing is about one third of the wheel diameter. The axial width of about 18.7mm was estimated from the side-view image scale, because the spec lists no width. The 4mm diameter of the four pattern holes was also estimated from the images (about 3.7mm measured). The bore is hex-shaped, so 8mm is treated as the across-flats size. The two small screws on the hub face (about 11mm from center along x) are not modeled as holes. The 14mm recess is stated in the specs, but its depth is not visible or stated.
